workstreams.title: Focused first release
workstreams.summary: Keeps the September 2027 first live Hub release bounded, useful and launchable, taking the release hypothesis through scope decisions, build, readiness, launch and early live learning.

workstreams.title: Wider journey discovery and roadmap
workstreams.summary: Builds the evidence base for what the Hub should deepen after the first release by mapping the wider student-facing estate, priority journeys, ownership, integration readiness and later rationalisation opportunities.

workstreams.title: Shared Hub platform foundations
workstreams.summary: Establishes and progressively matures the shared application foundations, integration patterns and common Hub capabilities that allow multiple student journeys to reuse one supported product layer.

workstreams.title: Student experience, co-design and validation
workstreams.owner: Product & Service Designer with Product Owner
workstreams.summary: Keeps student evidence and experience design threaded through discovery and delivery, using sustained co-design, wider research and product testing to shape the common home, access patterns and later priorities.
